top_repositories.name: Jarvis322/macos-sysdata
top_repositories.reason: Selected for offering practical, developer-focused utility to solve a notorious macOS annoyance regarding opaque system storage usage.
top_repositories.why_interesting_today: macOS developers frequently struggle with 'System Data' bloating their local SSDs; this lightweight SwiftUI menu bar app provides direct visibility and cleaning capabilities.
top_repositories.why_developers_should_care: It is a well-crafted Swift utility that saves manual terminal hunting and provides fine-grained disk cleanup.
top_repositories.momentum: Strong organic interest and clean implementation using modern SwiftUI and Xcode conventions.
top_repositories.novelty: Transforms a notoriously opaque operating system issue into an actionable, item-by-item menu bar control interface.

top_repositories.novelty: Bridges high-frequency decentralized prediction market data directly into local, zero-friction SQL analytics.
